settings.heading: Subscribe to a Library Plan
settings.text:
Subscribe to any Library plan of your choice from the website. We have a 3-month plan, a 6-month plan, and an annual plan for all our Book & Toy Library Subscriptions.  View all Library Plans.

View all library Plans

settings.heading: Download the neOwn App
settings.text: Get started by downloading our neOwn app.Sign in using your registered mobile number.(Through OTP Verification)Fill in your child’s information and link them to your order.

settings.heading: Select Your Library Books or Toys
settings.text: Then you can select any age-appropriate Books or Toys of your choice from our available catalogs. Search, filter, browse & select the perfect books or toys for your little one.

settings.heading: Home Delivery
settings.text: Once you have selected your books or toys, our team will send you a confirmation and then they will be delivered to your home within the next 2-5 working days. After delivery, you have 30 days to enjoy with your new books or toys! All delivery details will be availableon the app.

settings.heading: Return & Repeat
settings.text: Once you are done reading or playing with the toys (or after 30 days), you can select your next set of books or toys in the app. A pickup will be done for the previous set of books or toys and you will get a fresh new set of books or toys at your doorstep! And this same process will continue for all the months of your subscription.

settings.header: Do you deliver all over India?
settings.content:
Currently, we only deliver books all over India. 

Delivery is free within Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, and Mira-Bhayander. 

Outside Mumbai: There is an additional delivery charge for Book Library deliveries outside Mumbai. 

(Toy Library is only operating in Mumbai as of now)

settings.header: How does the Library Subscription work?
settings.content:
Step 1: 📚🧸You can subscribe to any plan from our website. 

Step 2: 📲Download the neOwn app to select your books or toys. 

Step 3: 📦Books/toys will be delivered and the pickup and exchange will happen after maximum 30 days

Step 4: 🔁Finally you return and repeat the same for all the following months of your subscription!

settings.header: How can I select my books/toys?
settings.content:
Once you have subscribed, you can download our app📲 from which you can select the books or toys 📚🧸

You can select any books/toys of your choice, and in case you are not sure what to pick we have a book expert in-house who can help you out if needed 💖

settings.header: How to download the neOwn app?
Is there any deposit or registration fee?
settings.content: No, there is no deposit or registration fee.

settings.header: I have books/toys at home that I want to donate, how can I do that?
settings.content: Please WhatsApp us at +91 9137081640 with your location and the details of your books/toys and we’ll get back to you!

settings.header: How do you sanitize the books & toys?
settings.content:
Our process to ensure the books & toys are hygenic and in good condition: 

  • All toys are cleaned by our team before and after they go to or come back from any customer to ensure they are 100% sanitary
  • ⁠⁠We also clean board books to ensure they are 100% sanitary 
  • ⁠We do a thorough check of all books & toys twice - once after they have come back from customers and the second time before they are going to another customer 
  • ⁠⁠If any books or toys are of bad quality we don't circulate it among customers anymore
